title: Sync
explain: When goroutines share a variable, they need protection or they race each other. `sync.Mutex` lets only one goroutine at a time into the code between `Lock` and `Unlock`. Run your program with `go run -race .` to have Go detect data races for you.
exercise: Remove the mutex, run the program with `go run -race .`, and read the race report.
tip: Share memory by communicating when you can. A channel often removes the need for a mutex altogether.
